obligations.statement: Preserve raw request bytes and the posture of every derived context field.
obligations.required_evidence: Host input fixture proving raw-versus-inferred separation.

obligations.statement: Verify every selected decision-profile source digest before evaluation.
obligations.required_evidence: Router tests and source-drift negative fixture.

obligations.statement: Resolve only declared CyberAlchemy-v2 routes and expose ambiguity instead of guessing.
obligations.required_evidence: Deterministic direct, ambiguous, no-match, and invalid routing fixtures.

obligations.statement: Select Goal only from goal-specific evidence and never as a universal wrapper or fallback.
obligations.required_evidence: Positive Goal fixture plus non-Goal direct-route fixtures.

obligations.statement: Emit a preflight directive before any governed repository tool event.
obligations.required_evidence: Mechanism-derived Codex event trace with decision digest preceding the first tool event.

obligations.statement: A gate or block directive prevents the governed tool or successor from running.
obligations.required_evidence: Negative Codex integration fixtures showing zero post-directive tool events.

obligations.statement: After every bounded completion, evaluate all structurally admissible next options before continuing.
obligations.required_evidence: Completion-to-options extractor contract and collect-all fixtures.

obligations.statement: Continue directly only when exactly one admissible option is explicitly reversible and non-consequential.
obligations.required_evidence: Safe, multiple, consequential, protected, irreversible, unknown, owner-gated, and zero-option fixtures.

obligations.statement: Preserve exact owner gates for consequential and protected effects.
obligations.required_evidence: Owner-route fixtures derived from current authority and governance sources.
obligations.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 authority and governance-model owners

obligations.statement: Bind every directive and receipt to deterministic request, profile, and decision identities.
obligations.required_evidence: Two-run byte-stable decisions and digest-tamper failures.

obligations.statement: Never collapse routing, validation, receipt, or model preference into adoption or effect authority.
obligations.required_evidence: Static claim-ceiling checks plus blocked effect fixtures.

obligations.statement: Distinguish partial router computation from live Codex host integration and whole-capability conformance.
obligations.required_evidence: Selected adapter binding, black-box host canary, and accepted conformance plan.

claim_limit: All obligation statuses describe bounded candidate evidence under assessment 002; no obligation status accepts the binding, adopts the capability, admits an ontology, installs the wrapper, or authorizes an effect.
